g.text: Dynamic array growth: keep the old block while copying to the new one
append(50) starts at size 4, capacity 4. Underscores mark unused slots.
1. Allocate a separate block of 8 slots; size stays 4.
Copy old[i] to new[i] for i = 0, 1, 2, 3. Both blocks exist during the copy.
2. Point data at the new block; set capacity to 8.
Release the old block when no longer needed. The values keep their indices.
3. Write 50 at index 4, then increase size to 5.
This append copied 4 old values. The next three appends need no resize.
